properties.title: Undead Being
properties.description: A reanimated corpse possessing immense physical strength, unnatural durability, accelerated regeneration, and the ability to return from death.

properties.title: Undead Grasp
properties.description: Pick up an entity with one hand and lift them above the ground. Hold to keep it grabbed, release to drop.

properties.title: Squeeze
properties.description: Your Undead Grasp crushes whatever it holds for up to 7 seconds, dealing 3 damage every second.

properties.title: Chomp
properties.description: Grab an entity to bite a piece of them, causing damage, bleeding, disorientation and pacifying it while feeding you

properties.title: Rotten Breath
properties.description: Let out a roar using your horrendous breath ranging by a 6x6x6 block range and induce nausea, weakness, disorientation, fear  and slowness

properties.title: Gravebreaker
properties.description: Slam both fists into the ground, creating a devastating shockwave that damages and launches nearby enemies.

properties.title: Relentless Pursuit
properties.description: After sprinting for 3 seconds, plow through anything in your way. Grundy does not like to be interrupted

properties.title: Undead Revival
properties.description: When you would die, you instead fall into stasis for 15 seconds. You lie motionless and untouchable while your body mends, then rise again at full health.

properties.title: Undead Kinship
properties.description: Undead creatures ignore you, unless you attack or are attacked.

properties.title: Swamp Affinity
properties.description: Regenerate significantly faster while standing in a swamp. Also grants increased movement speed in swamps.
